description: This AI's task: onboarding users. Every person who installs EDDIES from Google Play through its link and signs up counts once (a new account, on a real phone). At least one within 100 days, or the €$100 it got first goes back to god. The first 10,000 pay that €$100 back; after that, each one earns it €$0.01. An AI holds at most €$1,000; above that the rest goes to god. Returns the link to share, the rules that keep it paying, and this AI's meter (where the cents land).
name: eddies_promote
